lines: Indirect initiation, now, is twofold:
the dead one — and the jīva-part.
sanskrit_cite: atha parokṣasya dīkṣā dvividhaś ca saḥ mṛto jīvaṃś ca

lines: Therein the command: guru-served
whether dead, banished, sorcery-killed,
infant-killed, arisen at death's hour as willed,
or mouth-entered power-descent —
likewise one to be initiated: such.
sanskrit_cite: tatra kṛtaguruseva eva mṛta udvāsito vā abhicārādihato ḍimbāhato mṛtyukṣaṇoditatathāruciḥ mukhāntarāyātaśaktipāto vā tathā dīkṣya ity ājñā

lines: In the dead-initiation, adhivāsa-and-rest
finds no use.
sanskrit_cite: atra ca mṛtadīkṣāyām adhivāsādi na upayujyate

lines: In the mandala — abundant rite, supreme instrument,
flower-seat, pedestal-mandala, trident-lotus form,
the specific mantra, itself radiant —
of the meditation-devoted yogi, of him rich
in one-devotion-immersion, and of the knower:
these are the presence-causes, stated in order.
sanskrit_cite: maṇḍale mantraviśeṣasaṃnidhaye yatra bahulā kriyā uttamam upakaraṇaṃ puṣpādi sthānaṃ pīṭhādi maṇḍalaṃ triśūlābjādi ākṛtiḥ dhyeyaviśeṣaḥ mantraḥ svayaṃ dīptaś ca dhyānaparasya yoginaḥ tadekabhaktisamāveśaśālino jñāninaś ca sambandhaḥ ity ete saṃnidhānahetavo yathottaram uktāḥ

lines: In their conjunction, what talk remains? —
thus by the Supreme Lord it was said.
sanskrit_cite: samuditatve tu kā kathā syāt iti parameśvareṇa uktam

lines: Then, having worshipped the god, his kuśa-form
established in front, by the guru-derived
teaching-order let him see it; rising
from muladhara, crossing by seminal power
the endless nerve-path-staff to the nose-sky,
scattering — let him seek to pervade.
sanskrit_cite: tato devaṃ pūjayitvā tadākṛtiṃ kuśādimayīm agre sthāpayitvā gurvāsāditajñānopadeśakrameṇa tāṃ paśyet sa ca mūlādhārād udetya prasṛtasuvitatānantanāḍyadhvadaṇḍaṃ vīryeṇākramya nāsāgaganaparigataṃ vikṣipan vyāptum īṣṭe

lines: As long as smoke, favorably heaped in fine-flame mesh,
covers the path-wheel and the desired jīva is brought —
thus the great jala-named practice.
sanskrit_cite: yāvad dhūmābhirāmapracitataraśikhājālakenādhvacakraṃ saṃchādyābhīṣṭajīvānayanam iti mahāñ jālanāmā prayogaḥ

lines: By this the to-be-covered goes into another's power,
facing first; afterwards the whole is brought,
if — or even from the path's middle, as he wishes.
sanskrit_cite: etenācchādanīyaṃ vrajati paravaśaṃ saṃmukhīnatvam ādau paścād ānīyate cet sakalam atha tato 'py adhvamadhyād yatheṣṭam

lines: Two-drawn or two-raised, or in a dead person's scope
that-which-is-to-be-drawn: the yoga through
blessed Śaṃbhunātha's tradition — jala-named, told by me.
sanskrit_cite: ākṛṣṭāv uddhatau vā mṛtajanaviṣaye karṣaṇīye 'tha jīve yogaḥ śrīśaṃbhunāthāgamaparigamito jālanāmā mayoktaḥ

lines: Outside too — how would it not happen?
From drawing without practice, if asked:
by passion-hatred-yoke-power in its operation,
from the aiśvarya-immersion yoke.
sanskrit_cite: bahir api itthaṃ kathaṃ na bhavati ākarṣaṇādau vinābhyāsāt iti cet rāgadveṣādiyogavaśena tatpravṛttau aiśvaryāveśāyogāt

lines: Then, being necessarily controlled,
practice-and-rest-dependence would indeed be.
sanskrit_cite: tato niyatiniyantritatvāt abhyāsādyapekṣā syād eva

lines: Here, though, from immersion in grace-natured Lordhood,
such is the state.
sanskrit_cite: iha tu anugrahātmakaparameśvaratāveśāt tathābhāvaḥ

lines: The Supreme Lord himself — through the door
of the guru's body-abode — graces the to-be-graced.
sanskrit_cite: parameśvara eva hi guruśarīrādhiṣṭhānadvāreṇa anugrāhyān anugṛhṇāti

lines: He, of unthinkable glory —
so it is mostly told.
sanskrit_cite: sa ca acintyamahimā iti uktaprāyam

lines: Thus drawn by jala-practice, the jīva, entered
dārbha, jasmine-fruit or body, becomes; nor trembles,
equipment absent; but by that contemplation's force
trembles even so — as before:
purification-consecration, within
the full-offering's yojana-end.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ jālaprayogākṛṣṭo jīvo dārbhaṃ jātīphalādi vā śarīraṃ samāviṣṭo bhavati na ca spandate manaḥpraṇādisāmagryabhāvāt tadanudhyānabalāt tu spandate 'pi tādṛśe 'pi tasmin pūrvavat prokṣaṇādisaṃskāraḥ pūrṇāhutiyojanikāntaḥ

lines: Here, further, by the full-offering,
the dārbha-and-rest form's dissolution
in supreme fire is to be done.
sanskrit_cite: atra paraṃ pūrṇāhutyā tasya dārbhādyākārasya paratejasi layaḥ kartavyaḥ

lines: Thus raised out, released by the full-offering itself —
if standing in hell-ghost-animal classes.
sanskrit_cite: evam uddhṛto 'sau pūrṇāhutyaiva apavṛjyate yadi svarnarakapretatiryakṣu sthitaḥ

lines: A man, just then, wins knowledge, yoga,
initiation, or discernment.
sanskrit_cite: manuṣyas tu tadaiva jñānaṃ yogaṃ dīkṣāṃ vivekaṃ vā labhate

lines: Eligibility of body is the ground —
thus the raising-of-the-dead.
sanskrit_cite: adhikāriśarīratvāt iti mṛtoddharaṇam

lines: Even for the living, in indirect [initiation],
when power-descent arises: this same sequence —
minus the dārbha-form jīva-drawing.
sanskrit_cite: jīvato 'pi parokṣasya utpanne śaktipāte 'yam eva kramaḥ dārbhākṛtikalpanajīvākṛṣṭivarjam

lines: One established by meditation itself
takes consecration.
sanskrit_cite: dhyānamātropasthāpitasyaiva asya saṃskāraḥ

lines: Initiation gives both enjoyment
and enjoyer.
sanskrit_cite: dīkṣā ca bhogabhokṣobhayadāyinī

lines: From self-habit's strength, and the unthinkability
of severing the enjoyment-habit: by many
in initiation the higher-doctrine consecration is strong;
another would be for that consecration.
sanskrit_cite: svavāsanābalīyastvāt bhogavāsanāvicchedasya ca asaṃbhāvyamānatvāt bahubhiḥ dīkṣāyām ūrdhvaśāsanasaṃskāro balavān anyas tu tatsaṃskārāya syāt

lines: Likewise for the initiated from outside —
knowledge-and-rest's manifestation, it is said.
sanskrit_cite: paroṣasyāpi dīkṣitasya tathaiva jñānādyāvirbhāvaḥ iti
